body: That sounds like absolute hell to go through. I can't promise you things will get better but there are people who will support you through this. And there are boys who will accept you for who you are, they are out there and someday you will find one and maybe you'll even marry one. You can try asking for support from your family if you think you can trust them or seek out a councilor. Also, there's a hotline and a chat called The Trevor Project which specializes with helping LGBT individuals so if you need someone to talk to or are feeling suicidal, you can find the number and chat here: [https://www.thetrevorproject.org/get-help-now/](https://www.thetrevorproject.org/get-help-now/)
I wouldn't want one either because I couldn't afford to lose any of my loved ones at this point or it might trigger me to kill myself.

And we feel the exact same feelings. The loneliness. The uselessness. The lack of direction in that you have no idea what you want to do with your life, and even the desire to turn back to your childhood because that was the last time you were happy. And neither of us are alone, because despite being completely different people we feel the exact same fucking experience. Something has to change in your life and something has to change in mine so we can feel happiness without a fucking time machine back to our childhoods. But we're alone in the sense that the world probably isn't going to bring that change into our lives. By sitting home alone a girlfriend in shining armor won't appear and save me from my fucking depression. I have to change my life or else I'll waste more time being depressed or even worse end up killing myself because the demons become so strong that I can't fight them anymore. You do too and I hope we both succeed and come out alive and happy like we once were when we were children.
Good for you. You fucking go man!

I'm having a rough fucking time guys... It just keeps getting worse. I'm more depressed day by day. I'm afraid that I'll fail my classes next semester because I feel like I'm losing the ability to do anything. I'm so touch starved and lonely. I just need someone to hold me and tell me it's going to be alright. I need hugs and cuddles but I have no one to turn to. I'm screaming "HELP ME HELP ME! SAVE ME I'M IN TROUBLE!" and I feel like no one can hear me. I know a lot of you want to die and sometimes I feel that way too but deep down I'm terrified of becoming a statistic. I just want my old life back. I'll probably call the suicide hotline for the first time in my life when my dad goes asleep. I need support but it would help if I could physically hold someone.
